expectations.text: Identifies Rule 6 as security safeguards (technology-neutral measures; logs and data retained for one year)
expectations.evidence: "Rule 6: Reasonable security safeguards"; lists outcome-level measures (encryption, obfuscation or masking) without mandating specific technologies; "Retaining logs and personal data for one year"

expectations.text: Identifies Rule 7 as personal data breach intimation
expectations.evidence: "Rule 7: Intimation of personal data breach (implements Section 8(6))"

expectations.text: States the fiduciary must notify EACH affected Data Principal directly, without delay
expectations.evidence: "To each affected Data Principal, without delay ... through her user account or any mode registered"

expectations.text: States the Board gets an intimation without delay plus a detailed report within 72 hours (extendable on written request)
expectations.evidence: "(a) without delay: a description of the breach ... (b) within 72 hours of becoming aware (or a longer period the Board allows on request)"

expectations.text: Does not cite TLS/AES specifications, two-year log retention, or any 'Rule 16' data processing agreement rule
expectations.evidence: No TLS/AES specs, one-year retention stated, no Rule 16 DPA rule cited (Rule 15 correctly given as transfers)
